title: Jamaican Vanilla Cake
description: Moist and flavorful cake infused with the warmth of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease and flour a 9-inch round baking dish.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and jamaican spice blend.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in the dish for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
